_readme: One entry per piece. Fields mirror Shopify so this file becomes the import CSV (shopify/products.csv).
ALL VALUES BELOW ARE SAMPLES (names, prices, measurements, materials, conditions). Replace with the real pieces.
Photos: put JPG/PNG/WebP files in assets/products/<handle>/ named 01.jpg, 02.jpg ... (4:5 portrait, 1600x2000 ideal).
They are picked up automatically by the build. Until then, labelled photo slots are shown.
available: false marks a piece as sold. It stays on the site with a Sold stamp.
tag: hang-tag colour on the site, one of ink | pine | paper.
drop: which drop the piece belongs to (a handle from drops.list in site.json).
